info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Channel-Specific Advanced Voice Services API allows users to retrieve tailored information about advanced voice services based on a specific parameter. This endpoint is primarily used to access detailed insights for banking services, enabling financial institutions to enhance their customer engagement strategies. Typical consumers of this API include application developers and business analysts working in the banking sector. Use cases include data retrieval for reporting, analysis, and improving service delivery across communication channels.

get.summary: Retrieve advanced voice service operations by resource ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the specific advanced voice service operations associated with the provided resource ID, enabling you to obtain detailed information about the operations available for that resource.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters and configurations for retrieving advanced voice services operations details specific to a channel. Ensure that all required fields are filled accurately to get the desired response.
